title_en: Borrowing a Corpse to Return to Life
full_text_zh:
[P1] 借尸还魂

[P2] 汉朝的时候，吕太后有一个宠臣，名叫张石庆。有一天，张石庆下朝时，忽然听见路边有人大声喊："好马！好马！"他停下车往外看，只见一家客栈门口拴着一匹全身雪白的高头大马。那匹白马膘肥体壮，四肢有力。张石庆也不由得赞叹道："真是一匹千里马呀！"

[P3] 第二天下朝，张石庆又路过那家客栈。没想到，客栈门口又拴了一匹黑马，像昨天的白马一样健壮。张石庆非常喜欢，便让随从去打听，这两匹马是谁的。随从很快就来向他禀报："大人，那两匹马都是同一个人的，那人名叫田子春，是个马贩子。"

[P4] 原来，田子春一直想结识六官大使张石庆。听说张石庆爱马，他就故意将两匹宝马拴在了客栈门口。他又找到张石庆的家，碰巧见到张家旁边的房子要出租。田子春灵机一动，上前问看门人："请问，这宅子多少钱出租呀？"

[P5] “我是客栈里卖马的人，你回报张大人，他就知道了。”田子春微笑着说。

看门人抱着胳膊，瞥了田子春一眼，反问道：“这是张大人的房子，不是随便什么人都能来租的。你是谁呀？”

[P6] 果然，听了看门人的禀报后，张石庆立即吩咐，请田子春进门。还没等田子春行礼，张石庆就问他：“你那两匹马卖不卖，要多少钱？

田子春恭敬地答道：“我那两匹马是一对良驹，特地从齐鲁一带贩来的。大人喜欢的话，送给您就是了。反正我卖马也不是为了赚钱，只是想在衙门里找些事情做！”

[P7] 田子春把一黑一白两匹宝马，送到了张石庆那儿。从那以后，他每天溜须拍马，跟张石庆同进同出，高谈阔论，张石庆越来越信任他了。

"那还不简单！"张石庆高兴地说，"以后你跟着我，还怕不能飞黄腾达吗？"

[P8] 田子春好奇地问："大人，您是有什么烦恼吗？"张石庆又重重地叹口气说："唉，我是在为吕太后的事烦恼呀！近来，她一直想封她的侄子们为王……"

有一天，田子春陪张石庆喝酒。张石庆"滋溜"呷了一口酒，放下酒杯时，却长长地叹了一口气。

[P9] 张石庆气鼓鼓地说："你这话没有错！可是，高祖有遗命，只有他们姓刘的人才能封王。大臣们没有敢为吕太后的侄子们说话的，这件事不好办呀！"
田子春大笑着说："当年高祖做皇帝，给他的兄弟、侄子们都封了王侯；现在吕太后掌权，要封赏她的侄子们，也没什么不对呀！"

[P10] 田子春边给张石庆倒酒，边说："正因为事情不好办，办好了，功劳才会更大。不如大人找一些大臣，让他们一起在朝堂上奏请封吕太后的侄子们为王。吕太后一定会很高兴的，说不定还要给大人升官呢！"张石庆的眼珠子转了转，觉得田子春的办法不错！

[P11] 当天晚上，张石庆就把这件事告诉了几个大臣。第二天一上朝，这几个大臣就奏请封吕太后的三个侄子吕台、吕产、吕禄为王。张石庆也表示支持。
太后高兴极了，除了将三个侄子封王，又赏给张石庆千两黄金。

[P12] "哈哈，你的计策真是太妙了！"张石庆高兴地分了一半黄金给田子春。可是，田子春却把黄金退还给了张石庆。他一拍脑袋，后悔地说："我酒后胡言，出了这么个坏主意，真是坏了太后的大事呀！"张石庆疑惑地问："这怎么会坏事呢？"

[P13] 张石庆听他这么一说，也着急起来，连忙问："那可怎么办呀？"
"现在只有一个办法了。"田子春趴在张石庆耳边小声地说出他的计策。
田子春说："您想呀，吕太后一下子封了三个侄子为王，刘姓王族肯定不高兴，万一他们造起反来，不就糟糕了吗？"

[P14] 这天晚上，张石庆连夜进宫见了吕太后，小心翼翼地对她说："太后，三吕封王，刘姓王族心中不服，想造反呢！"
太后问道："那你有什么办法？"
"可不可以这样？"张石庆说，"营陵侯刘泽，无官无职，无兵无权，您划出十几个县，封他为王，再分给他一点兵马。这样一来，刘姓王族也得了好处，他们不就没有意见了吗？"

[P15] 吕太后听了张石庆的建议，封营陵侯刘泽为琅琊王，给他划了封地，还拨给他二十万大军。
刘泽接受封赏后，立刻率领二十万大军出了长安。没过多久，田子春也骑着黑马，带着白马飞奔赶来。原来，田子春是刘泽的门客。他来到长安，就是为了帮助刘泽获取兵马的。

[P16] 田子春借张石庆的口，帮助无兵无权的刘泽取得了封地和兵马。像这样借助别人的势力，为自己谋取利益的计策，就叫“借尸还魂”。
吕太后知道上当之后，狠狠地责罚了张石庆。可是，送出去的兵马，却再也讨不回来了。
full_text_en:
[P1] Borrowing a Corpse to Return a Soul

[P2] During the Han Dynasty, Empress Lü had a favorite minister named Zhang Shiqing. One day, as Zhang Shiqing was returning from court, he suddenly heard someone shouting by the roadside: "Good horse! Good horse!" He stopped his carriage and looked out, and saw a pure white, tall horse tied up at the entrance of an inn. The white horse was plump and strong, with powerful limbs. Zhang Shiqing couldn't help but exclaim: "Truly a thousand-mile horse!"

[P3] The next day after court, Zhang Shiqing passed by that inn again. To his surprise, there was another black horse tied at the inn's entrance, as strong as the white horse from yesterday. Zhang Shiqing liked it very much and sent his attendant to find out who the two horses belonged to. The attendant soon reported back: "Master, both horses belong to the same person. His name is Tian Zichun, and he is a horse dealer."

[P4] Originally, Tian Zichun had always wanted to get to know the high-ranking official Zhang Shiqing. Hearing that Zhang Shiqing loved horses, he deliberately tied two fine horses outside the inn. He then went to Zhang Shiqing's home and, by chance, saw a house next to Zhang's house for rent. Tian Zichun had a sudden idea and approached the gatekeeper, asking: "Excuse me, how much is this house for rent?"

[P5] "I'm the man selling horses at the inn. Just tell Master Zhang, and he'll know," said Tian Zichun with a smile.

The gatekeeper, arms crossed, glanced at Tian Zichun and retorted, "This is Master Zhang's house. Not just anyone can rent it. Who are you?"

[P6] Sure enough, after hearing the gatekeeper's report, Zhang Shiqing immediately ordered, 'Let Tian Zichun come in.' Before Tian Zichun could bow, Zhang Shiqing asked him, 'Are you selling those two horses? How much do you want for them?

Tian Zichun respectfully replied, 'Those two horses are a pair of fine steeds, specially brought from the Qilu region. If you like them, I'll give them to you. After all, I'm not selling them for profit—I just want to find some work in the government office!'

[P7] Tian Zichun delivered a black and a white fine horse to Zhang Shiqing. From then on, he flattered him every day, going in and out together, chatting and discussing, and Zhang Shiqing grew to trust him more and more.

"That's not difficult at all!" Zhang Shiqing said happily, "If you follow me, how could you not rise to success?"

[P8] Tian Zichun curiously asked, "Sir, do you have any troubles?" Zhang Shiqing sighed heavily again, "Ah, I'm troubled by the matter of Empress Dowager Lü! Lately, she has been trying to make her nephews kings..."

One day, Tian Zichun accompanied Zhang Shiqing in drinking wine. Zhang Shiqing "slurped" a sip of wine, then, when he put down his cup, sighed deeply.

[P9] Zhang Shiqing said angrily, "You're right! But the High Ancestor left a decree: only those with the surname Liu can be enfeoffed as kings. The ministers dare not speak up for the nephews of Empress Lü. This matter is difficult to handle!"
Tian Zichun laughed loudly, "When the High Ancestor was emperor, he enfeoffed his brothers and nephews as kings and marquises. Now that Empress Lü holds power and wants to reward her nephews, what's wrong with that!"

[P10] Tian Zichun poured wine for Zhang Shiqing while saying: "Exactly because the matter is difficult, if we succeed, the merit will be even greater. Why not, sir, find some ministers and have them jointly petition in court to crown the nephews of Empress Lü as kings? Empress Lü will surely be very pleased, and perhaps even promote you!" Zhang Shiqing's eyes darted around, thinking Tian Zichun's idea was not bad!

[P11] That evening, Zhang Shiqing told several ministers about this matter. The next day, when court convened, these ministers petitioned to enfeoff the three nephews of Empress Dowager Lü—Lü Tai, Lü Chan, and Lü Lu—as kings. Zhang Shiqing also expressed his support.
Empress Dowager Lü was overjoyed. Besides enfeoffing her three nephews as kings, she also rewarded Zhang Shiqing with a thousand taels of gold.

[P12] "Haha, your plan is simply brilliant!" Zhang Shiqing happily gave half the gold to Tian Zichun. However, Tian Zichun returned the gold to Zhang Shiqing. He slapped his forehead, regretfully saying, "I spoke recklessly while drunk, suggesting such a terrible idea. I've truly ruined the Empress Dowager's great matter!" Zhang Shiqing asked in confusion, "How could this possibly be a bad thing?"

[P13] Zhang Shiqing, upon hearing this, became anxious and hurriedly asked, "What should we do then?"
"There's only one way now," Tian Zichun whispered into Zhang Shiqing's ear, revealing his plan.
Tian Zichun said, "Think about it—Empress Lü has just made three of her nephews kings. The Liu clan princes will surely be unhappy. What if they rebel? Won't that be disastrous?"

[P14] That night, Zhang Shiqing hurried to the palace to see Empress Dowager Lü. He spoke to her cautiously: "Your Majesty, the three Lüs have been made kings, and the Liu clan princes are dissatisfied and may even rebel!"
Empress Dowager asked, "Then what can be done?"
"Could it be done like this?" Zhang Shiqing said, "Lord Liu Ze of Yingling has no official post, no troops, and no power. If you assign him十几个 counties and make him a king, then give him a small army, the Liu clan princes will benefit too. Wouldn't they then have no complaints?"

[P15] Empress Lü, following Zhang Shiqing's advice, enfeoffed Liu Ze, the Marquis of Yingling, as King of Langya, granted him territory, and allocated twenty thousand troops to him.
After accepting the rewards, Liu Ze immediately led his twenty-thousand-strong army out of Chang'an. Not long after, Tian Zichun arrived galloping on a black horse, accompanied by a white horse. Originally, Tian Zichun was Liu Ze's guest. He had come to Chang'an specifically to help Liu Ze obtain troops.

[P16] Tian Zichun, using Zhang Shiqing's words, helped Liu Ze, who had no troops or power, obtain land and military forces. Such a strategy of leveraging others' power to gain personal benefits is called 'borrowing a corpse to return a soul'.
After realizing she had been deceived, Empress Dowager Lü severely punished Zhang Shiqing. However, the troops that had been sent out could never be retrieved.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，展示标题“借尸还魂”，并配有一名古代男子夹在两匹马之间的插图，画面充满趣味性。
[P2] 本页讲述了汉朝宠臣张石庆在下朝途中，被路边叫卖声吸引，发现一匹膘肥体壮的白色高头大马，并赞叹其为千里马的故事。
[P3] 张石庆再次路过客栈，发现又有一匹健壮的黑马，他十分喜欢，便让随从打听马的主人，得知是马贩子田子春。
[P4] 本页揭示了马贩子田子春为结识张石庆而设下的计谋：他先将两匹宝马拴在客栈门口，又发现张石庆家旁有房出租，便上前询问租金，意图接近张石庆。
[P5] 马贩子田子春为接近张石庆，主动询问其府邸旁出租房屋的租金，看门人怀疑其身份并质问他是谁。
[P6] 张石庆在得知马贩子田子春前来后立即请其进门，并询问马匹价格；田子春则恭敬地表示愿将两匹宝马相赠，称自己并非为赚钱，而是想在衙门谋个差事。
[P7] 田子春将两匹宝马送给张石庆，从此每日奉承讨好，与张石庆形影不离，逐渐获得其信任。张石庆对田子春的前途充满信心，承诺带他飞黄腾达。
[P8] 本页描绘了马贩子田子春陪张石庆饮酒的场景，张石庆因吕太后欲封其侄子为王而烦恼，田子春在一旁关切询问，展现了二人关系的亲近。
[P9] 张石庆因吕太后欲封其侄子为王而烦恼，田子春在一旁劝说，认为此举并无不妥，二人在饮酒时讨论朝政，展现了他们关系的亲近。
[P10] 田子春在为张石庆倒酒时，建议他联合大臣上奏封吕太后的侄子为王，以博取吕太后的欢心和升官机会，张石庆听后觉得此计不错。
[P11] 张石庆将田子春的建议告知几位大臣，众人联名上奏请求封吕太后的三个侄子为王，吕太后大喜，不仅封王，还赏赐张石庆千两黄金。
[P12] 张石庆因田子春的计策成功而高兴，分给他一半黄金，但田子春却因酒后失言而后悔，将黄金退还，并担心此举会坏了太后的大事，张石庆对此感到疑惑。
[P13] 田子春向张石庆提出担忧，认为吕太后封三个侄子为王可能引发刘姓王族不满，甚至导致叛乱，张石庆听后焦急询问对策，田子春随即低声献上计策。
[P14] 张石庆连夜进宫面见吕太后，告知刘姓王族对三吕封王不满，可能造反。吕太后询问对策，张石庆建议封无权无势的营陵侯刘泽为王，以安抚刘姓王族，平息不满。
[P15] 吕太后采纳张石庆建议，封刘泽为琅琊王并赐予封地和二十万大军；刘泽率军出长安后，其门客田子春也骑马赶来，目的是协助刘泽获取兵马。
[P16] 本页揭示了田子春利用张石庆的名义帮助刘泽获得封地和兵马的计谋，此计被称为“借尸还魂”。吕太后识破后惩罚了张石庆，但已送出的兵马无法收回。
